example.title: Lemuel C. and Mary (Vaughn) Boughton House, 736 W. Cedar St.

brief: Two-and-a-half-storey late Queen Anne / Free Classic house in pale grey clapboard: a hipped roof with a big pedimented front gable (paired attic windows, shingled tympanum) over a canted second-floor bay framed by little arched brackets. A deep wraparound porch with square brick-and-wood piers and a flat roof runs across the front and around the side. Ornate cast-iron fence with tall gateposts on a low concrete retaining wall at the sidewalk.
